one_line_root_cause: Statistics propagation folds a pushed-down table filter and leaves an invalid column index behind, tripping an assertion instead of returning no rows.
An expression rewrite rebuilds a comparison against a constant without rebinding the scalar function, so binding fails at execution.
The sorted window-aggregate path returns wrong sums once it spills under a memory limit, so large FLOAT partitions silently lose contributions.
Performance regression, not a wrong result: the pad implementation stopped taking its ASCII fast path when the pad string mixes ASCII and multi-byte characters.
The shell overwrites the whole active_grammar_extensions setting instead of appending to it, disabling grammars other loaded extensions registered.
EXPLAIN (SQL) prints the post-rewrite plan, where a constant quantile argument has become a column reference, so the exported SQL is not replayable.
Parser error positions are counted in bytes but reported as character offsets, so multi-byte Unicode whitespace shifts the reported location.
The SQL formatter tokenises $name parameters without protecting them, injecting whitespace and treating keyword-named parameters as clause keywords.
The list-comprehension rewrite rebuilds the lambda body without its explicit casts, so the result keeps the pre-cast type and the wrong values.
Statistics propagation over an ungrouped aggregate on an empty table concludes the filter is always true, so LIMIT 1 is discarded and three rows come back.
INSERT with ON CONFLICT, OR IGNORE or OR REPLACE skips the column-list validation the plain path performs, so bad column lists insert wrong rows or hit an internal error.
The IN-clause rewrite duplicates its left-hand side, so a volatile expression such as nextval() is evaluated once per alternative instead of once.
COMMENT ON resolves a nested catalog.schema.schema.table name with the two-part qualification rule, so deeply nested schemas are rejected as over-qualified.
TRY does not suppress the error from a cast inside it because unused-column removal rewrites the expression out of the TRY scope, while TRY_CAST handles it directly.
A RIGHT_ANTI hash join emitting its unmatched rows feeds a window operator a payload it does not own, segfaulting in dense_rank() OVER ().
A hash join whose probe side projects no columns gives the partitioning code a zero tuple width, which it rejects with an internal error.
SET parses an unquoted qualified value as a qualified name and keeps only its last part, so a dotted setting value is silently truncated.
ALTER TABLE on a foreign-key child rebuilds the table entry without its parent dependency, so the parent becomes renameable and CHECKPOINT then hangs.
The join-order optimizer reconstructs filters by the columns they reference, so a filter referencing no column at all (WHERE NULL) is dropped entirely.
Statistics propagation folds an aggregate whose HAVING is always true into an empty expression list, which the expression executor asserts against.
Grouping-set expansion re-binds SUM to the internal sum_no_overflow variant and then rejects it as internal-only when HAVING references the same aggregate.
LEAD with its own argument ORDER BY sorts only by the leading key, so two orderings that are equivalent for the frame produce different results.
Deferred unique constraints are treated as enforced functional dependencies, so the optimizer removes grouping and filtering that the deferred key does not guarantee.
ON CONFLICT inner-conflict detection compares NULL keys as equal, so two rows with a NULL unique column collide and one is silently dropped.
LEAD adds its offset to the row index without an overflow check, so a BIGINT-maximum offset either returns the default or throws depending on the vector boundary reached.
The IEJoin operator builds the non-preserved side's payload without handling nested types, so a LIST column on that side crashes with an internal error.
date_trunc on week and isoyear does signed arithmetic on the day counter without range checks, so dates near the minimum overflow.
Statistics propagation decides a subquery over an empty table yields no rows and rewrites the enclosing EXISTS to a constant, inverting the correlated result.
Plan-quality complaint rather than a wrong result: a huge LIMIT plus OFFSET over a cross product is not simplified, so the plan scans far more than it needs.
round_even has no DECIMAL overload, so a NUMERIC argument is coerced to DOUBLE first and the half-to-even rounding is applied to an inexact value.
Casting an anonymous ROW to JSON uses the struct writer, producing a JSON object keyed by positional names instead of the JSON array the unnamed row implies.
Foreign-key checks read committed state without taking a dependency on the concurrent transaction, so a rolled-back delete can leave the constraint inconsistent.
Inside a lambda the binder resolves a struct field access followed by a method-style call as a qualified name, so struct retrieval fails to bind.
A macro body containing a subquery is expanded before its inner correlated names are bound, so a lambda referencing a subquery column fails to bind.
The same macro expansion problem with a CTE: the CTE scope is not visible when the lambda body is bound, so the column cannot be resolved.
A correlated scalar subquery is cached per distinct correlation value, so a volatile function inside it is evaluated once instead of once per row.
Multiple in-memory instances derive the same temp-directory path, so concurrent JSON function state clashes between them.
A RIGHT join whose build side is a nested loop of identity hash joins keeps a dictionary vector alive past its owner, so the probe reads a stale dictionary.
The aggregate-function rewriter rewrites an ordered list() but leaves the GROUPING() binding pointing at the pre-rewrite grouping set.
Importing an aggregate state trusts the k field from user input and preallocates k entries, so a huge k asks for terabytes before any validation.
A variable ROWS ... PRECEDING bound computed per row is clamped with stale boundary state, so frames that should be empty come back non-empty.
Plan-quality issue: UNION keeps its duplicate-elimination aggregate even when one branch is provably empty, so the distinct work is redundant.
Struct comparison returns false instead of NULL when a member is NULL, so IS NULL on the comparison filters out rows that should qualify.
A LEFT join condition that references only the left table on one side leaves the join with no build-side keys, and the operator indexes into an empty vector.
The PostgreSQL row-text cast treats an empty field as an empty string rather than NULL, so missing trailing fields parse to the wrong value.
Reusable column aliases are resolved before a joined macro is expanded, so an alias defined earlier in the same SELECT list is not visible.
The BLOB to BIT cast is registered as non-fallible, so TRY_CAST of an empty BLOB raises a fatal error instead of returning NULL.
The LIKE optimizer assumes its pattern argument is constant-foldable and discards the filter when a CASE pattern evaluates to NULL, so every row survives.
Performance regression: repeated json_serialize_sql calls rebuild per-call serializer state that the previous release reused.
The compensated-summation combine step adds the compensation term with the wrong sign, so merging partial states doubles the error instead of cancelling it.
The approximate join-order search emits an ANTI join with a projection map that does not match the operator's output, fatally invalidating the database.
The optimizer applies De Morgan's law to a predicate over a NULL BOOLEAN as if NOT were two-valued, so the two equivalent forms disagree.
WAL replay applies interleaved ALTER TABLE and CREATE INDEX entries without rebinding index buffers, so replayed index state points at the old column layout.
The streaming pipeline flushes a streaming LEAD operator twice when a following UNNEST stops early, so the final row is emitted a second time.
The list remapper allocates its list_entry_t array without initialising it, so unwritten entries carry garbage offsets into the allocator.
When the hash-join build side spills to disk, the pushed-down join filter is applied against in-memory partition bounds only, so matching probe rows are dropped.
The UNNEST rewriter in the FROM clause assumes a variable-size LIST, so a fixed-size ARRAY has no list offsets and the child vector access aborts.
On a shredded VARIANT column the JSON cast takes the string path and re-parses the extracted value instead of serialising the variant.
struct_update() produces a struct whose statistics do not list every child, so comparing it to its source struct aborts in the struct statistics code.
The sort key encoding normalises negative zero to positive zero and the sorted payload is rebuilt from that key, so -0.0 loses its sign.
